name: balance
description: Pick a Claude account and launch Claude Code with it. Manages isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIRs so one machine can hold multiple Claude Code accounts side-by-side.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile dist/balance && ([ "$(uname)" = Darwin ] && (codesign --remove-signature dist/balance 2>/dev/null; codesign --sign - --force --deep dist/balance) || true)
